reference.title: preview-contexts.yaml reference
reference.shortdesc: Sample readers for the previewer. Each is what the entitlement service would produce for a signed-in reader.

section.codeblock: contexts: self-hoster: org: acme products: [core] version: '0.1' managed-customer: org: globex products: [hosted, embed] features: [] version: '0.1'

property.propdesc: Shown in the banner, and on the cover of PDFs printed in the previewer. It does not affect filtering.
The release the reader runs, such as 0.1. Quote it.

section.p: Each name becomes an entry in the banner's Preview as list, and a value for --as. A malformed file is reported as invalid-preview-contexts.

section.title: Choosing sample readers
section.p: Cover each combination that changes what readers see: every product, the features that gate whole topics, and each release line you publish. Also include a reader with nothing, to check that the ungated pages still make sense on their own. The previewer only shows these readers; it does not check them against your real organizations.
